If you're looking for noise-cancelling headphones with a microphone, I'd recommend over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation (ANC) and good voice pickup.

One important distinction:

Noise cancellation (ANC): Reduces background noise you hear.

Microphone noise reduction: Reduces background noise other people hear during calls.

For Zoom meetings, Teams calls, or working in noisy environments, you'll want both.
